phase1_leaf_result.part107_scope: Bounded official-GitHub audit of pull-request hidden refs and pull-request service identity as a default service-side monotonic rollback witness coupled to Contents-API CAS publication.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: refs/pull/N/head is service-managed/read-only to ordinary pushes but tracks the latest pull-request head commit, so it is movable rather than an immutable generation pin. PR/witness creation is also a distinct effect from Contents-CAS publication, leaving missing-witness/orphan-witness ambiguity and no documented monotonic freshness fence.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A GitHub-native service-side witness with monotonic freshness across history rollback, non-rebindable accepted-generation identity, and atomic or deterministically reconcilable coupling to repository publication.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only retrieved official GitHub pull-request, inactive-PR, REST pull-request, and Enterprise Server garbage-collection documentation plus a bounded dual-write trace model; Enterprise Server retention was not generalized to GitHub.com permanence.

continuation: Part108: execute one bounded public-source leaf on GitHub immutable releases/release-tag locking as the next service-side witness class. Audit whether an empty/no-asset immutable release can pin a generation without finite storage/bandwidth quota, whether immutability prevents tag move/delete and release mutation after publication, service-side object ID/incarnation freshness and discoverability after branch/history rollback, repository-owner disable/delete paths, and dual-write ambiguity between Contents-CAS generation publication and release creation. Accept only documented zero-cost, zero-finite-quota, no-richer-mode semantics with deterministic reconciliation; otherwise persist the next candidate class without executing it in the same invocation.
